topic: Compilation of rare, one-in-a-trillion football moments (long goals, own-goal-like fails, celebrations)
hero: Various football players (unidentified, Di Maria, Mbappe, etc.)
hook: Wide shot of long-range goal attempt with green label "99.9%" and TEOCR logo watermark
subtitle_style: Small yellow captions in bold black outline (e.g., WTF HAPPENED HERE?); timers 00:01-00:08 in yellow-on-black box; distance labels (53M)
reaction_overlays: Red circle highlight tracking ball/player, PLAY button tag top-left, timer overlays, distance dotted line, TEOCR watermark top-right, percentage label
transition_summary: Medium-fast: cuts about every 2-4 s (cuts at 1.4, 10.3, 12, 24, 34.6, 45, 48.6, 52.6, 55.2, 67.6), highlight rings and on-screen timers mimic analysis style
audio_note: Voice/commentary from original clips plus likely music (transcript shows [Music])
